value.rationale: The enhanced odd-width arithmetic obstruction for even repetition counts is a natural complete invariant for the repeated-block Waring family; an odd-width restriction can change gcd from 1 to b^k-1 (at binary power-of-two repetition counts), and two short widths certify the entire infinite odd-width gcd. This has a clear role in interpreting digit-length-restricted additive reachability without overstating any bounded Waring theorem.
